name: ig-unfollowers
description: Secure, lightweight browser utility to detect Instagram unfollowers.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --loader:.svg=text --minify --outfile=dist/index.min.js && node scripts/create-extension-icons.js && node scripts/update-html.js
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && (cd extension && zip -r extension.zip .)
